slides.subtitle: Histogram gradient boosting predicts a large movement within 30 minutes

body.description: 13 market features plus nine condition features. Price, momentum, volatility, activity and trade age.
600 iterations add small trees to reduce log loss. At most seven leaves per tree capture nonlinear interactions.
120,000 earlier observations. Fold 4 selects the configuration. Output: movement probability at each five-minute decision.

body.description: Historical development gains remain unconfirmed under October conditions. Next: calibration, feature ablations and a separate frozen evaluation.
Relaxed unsigned policy context reaches 144 articles and 1,056 existing rows. Latest fold: six articles and 17 rows. No new predictive result.
Review the 100-article context packet and identify repeated episodes. Compare content with strong market and exposure/timing controls. Keep V4 frozen.
